difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that unramifiedness of a morphism of algebraic spaces is equivalent to being formally unramified together with the appropriate local finiteness condition. The proof passes to a diagram of charts, applies the schemes-side equivalence to the chart morphism, and descends the conclusion using etale locality of the properties involved. Descending through the chart while keeping track of the finiteness condition is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 2840-2864.

Conclusion difference: none in substance, both identify unramifiedness with formal unramifiedness plus the finiteness condition.
